description: Offline-first integration between GitHub Spec Kit and ACKit, mapping specification artifacts into deterministic tasks, verification, completion gates and handoffs.
rules: Use the maintained guides and references for ACKit Spec Kit Bridge; archived task records and past release notes are historical evidence.
Preserve existing offline-first behavior; do not require network services, telemetry or untrusted plugins for the product runtime.
Do not treat generated verification results as valid without the documented evidence and freshness checks.
